Law students remanded to custody after Supreme Court disruption

Two law students have been sent to judicial custody by a Delhi court following their arrest for causing a ruckus inside the Supreme Court. The incident led to the disruption of court proceedings. The court's decision follows their apprehension for the alleged disruption.
